ارعويت (form IX)
# اِرْعَوَيْتُ (irʕawaytu) /ir.ʕa.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْعَوَى (irʕawā)
# اِرْعَوَيْتَ (irʕawayta) /ir.ʕa.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْعَوَى (irʕawā)
# اِرْعَوَيْتِ (irʕawayti) /ir.ʕa.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْعَوَى (irʕawā)
